<div class="card-body">
'''Targeting Computer''' is a [[Light]] [[Device]] from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">照準コンピュータ</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">2フォース消費し、任意の宇宙船に配備する。この宇宙船が戦闘時に武器を使う場合、二回攻撃できる。二つの目標を攻撃してもよいし、運命数を足して1つの目標に使ってもよい。攻撃時には、それぞれの運命数を求める際に－1する。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-39o-Video.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">反乱軍の宇宙戦闘機用に特別に設計された。パイロットが宇宙魚雷を発射するときの補助装置。自動的に目標に照準を合わせるようにプログラムされている。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Targeting Computer.

'''Card text:''' Use 2 Force to deploy on any starship. If that starship uses a weapon in battle, it may fire twice. It may attack two targets, or add the destiny draws against one target. Subtract 1 from each destiny draw when firing.

'''Lore:''' Designed for Rebel starfighters. An aid when a pilot fires space torpedoes. Programmed to lock onto the target automatically.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The English adds 1 to maneuver.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Targeting Computer]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 100. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
